title: youngia cineripappa
intro: Youngia cineripappa, commonly known as the Indian dandelion or Bhedani, is a plant species in the sunflower family native to India. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Youngia cineripappa are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which help in soothing digestive issues and relieving respiratory problems. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
